Author: Jasmine
Name: Aetherstream
Description: Puts a live stream on a screen anchored in the world: place it on a wall, size it, and watch while you play. Plays Twitch, YouTube, Plex, direct streams and thousands of live TV channels, painted onto a real in-game surface so the game lights and occludes it properly. Party groups let a room watch the same thing together from a six-character code.
Punchline: A screen in the world, showing whatever is live.
